verdict.rationale: Calendly documents multiple event types: pre-built one-on-one, multi-host and group types, plus an API/MCP tool to create a new event type and per-event-type availability. The per-type settings the story names are largely unevidenced, and a community report says Calendly refused to add manual booking confirmation. Missing for 10: documented per-event-type duration, location and custom-question settings, any confirmation/approval rules (a user reports Calendly declined manual confirmation), and clarity on plan limits (a user reports only one meeting configuration without paying).

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer multiple event types with their own durations, locations, custom questions, and confirmation rules

citations.quote: Whether you're booking one-on-one appointments, multi-host sales demos, or group classes, Calendly offers pre-built event types that make scheduling easy for everyone.
